name: cleanmark-monorepo
description: 净印 monorepo：TypeScript 水印库 + Electron 桌面应用

scripts.test: npm run test -w @cleanmark/lib && npm run test -w @cleanmark/app
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @cleanmark/app
scripts.start:dev: npm run build && npm run start:dev -w @cleanmark/app
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @cleanmark/app
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win -w @cleanmark/app
scripts.package:all: npm run build && npm run package -w @cleanmark/app && npm run package:win -w @cleanmark/app
